title: Vulkan Mobile: validation layer error VUID-vkCmdDrawIndexed-None-08600
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1.stable, 4.5.beta5

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta5 - EndeavourOS  SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 02 Aug 2025 01:20:06 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV RENOIR) - AMD Ryzen 7 4800U with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 14.98 GiB memory

### Issue description

Running a scene with shader materials can cause vvl error (with `--gpu-validation`), this only happends on Mobile renderer:

```
...
ERROR: Vulkan Debug Report: object - 1839482953270921
vkCmdDrawIndexed(): The VkPipeline 0x6890000000689 (created with VkPipelineLayout 0x5e800000005e8) statically uses descriptor set 2, but all sets 0 to 2 are not compatible with the pipeline layout bound with vkCmdBindDescriptorSets (VkPipelineLayout 0x5ac00000005ac)
Set 0 binding 0 pImmutableSamplers 0xdab6030 doesn't match 0xde199e0
The Vulkan spec states: For each set n that is statically used by a bound shader, a descriptor set must have been bound to n at the same pipeline bind point, with a VkPipelineLayout that is compatible for set n, with the VkPipelineLayout used to create the current VkPipeline or the VkDescriptorSetLayout array used to create the current VkShaderEXT , as described in Pipeline Layout Compatibility (https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/drawing.html#VUID-vkCmdDrawIndexed-None-08600)
...
```

It is different if running editor to open the project:
```
...
ERROR: Vulkan Debug Report: object - 812904400
vkCmdDraw(): VkPipeline 0x3e090000003e09 uses set 0 but that set is not bound. (Need to use a command like vkCmdBindDescriptorSets to bind the set).
The Vulkan spec states: For each set n that is statically used by a bound shader, a descriptor set must have been bound to n at the same pipeline bind point, with a VkPipelineLayout that is compatible for set n, with the VkPipelineLayout used to create the current VkPipeline or the VkDescriptorSetLayout array used to create the current VkShaderEXT , as described in Pipeline Layout Compatibility (https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/drawing.html#VUID-vkCmdDraw-None-08600)
   at: _debug_report_callback (drivers/vulkan/rendering_context_driver_vulkan.cpp:665)
...
```

### Steps to reproduce

Run the scene with ` --gpu-validation --rendering-method mobile ` :

```tscn
[gd_scene load_steps=6 format=3 uid="uid://bst3sk48fjtsh"]

[sub_resource type="Shader" id="Shader_a202f"]
code = "shader_type spatial;
"

[sub_resource type="ShaderMaterial" id="ShaderMaterial_noarx"]
render_priority = 0
shader = SubResource("Shader_a202f")

[sub_resource type="BoxMesh" id="BoxMesh_a202f"]

[sub_resource type="Shader" id="Shader_4xowi"]
code = "shader_type spatial;
"

[sub_resource type="ShaderMaterial" id="ShaderMaterial_a202f"]
render_priority = 0
shader = SubResource("Shader_4xowi")

[node name="Node3D" type="Node3D"]

[node name="MeshInstance3D" type="MeshInstance3D" parent="."]
transform = Transform3D(1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0.784807, 0, 0)
material_override = SubResource("ShaderMaterial_noarx")
mesh = SubResource("BoxMesh_a202f")

[node name="MeshInstance3D2" type="MeshInstance3D" parent="."]
transform = Transform3D(1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, -0.640745, 0, 0)
material_override = SubResource("ShaderMaterial_a202f")
mesh = SubResource("BoxMesh_a202f")

[node name="Camera3D" type="Camera3D" parent="."]
transform = Transform3D(1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1.37335)

```
